<think>With K I am in the middle of the deck, so I should respect that A dominates me while J is behind. If I bet every time I create pressure, but I also risk putting chips in against a stronger range that can continue. In a toy Kuhn setting, balancing matters less than preserving a simple disciplined line. Checking keeps the pot controlled, protects against overcommitting with a medium-strength hand, and still lets me react to later aggression without forcing a thin value bet now.</think>
